hits.title: Print Industry Channel Transformation Gains Urgency as Partners Seek Sustainable Growth and Diversification - Quocirca
hits.snippet: Quocirca’s State of the Channel 2026 study reveals growing customer demand for cloud, workflow, security, and AI services but highlights execution and enablement challenges for print channel partners. [...] London, UK, 8 September 2026 – Quocirca today released its new State of the Channel, 2026 study, revealing a sector in a critical evolutionary phase. Channel partners recognise the need to diversify beyond traditional print revenue streams, but many face persistent challenges in transitioning to offer services-led business models. [...] Print industry channel partners remain broadly optimistic about their future prospects. Half of respondents expect revenues to increase in 2026 compared to 2025, and a further 27% expect them to remain stable. Growth expectations are modest, with respondents forecasting average revenue uplift of just 3.5% in 2026.

hits.title: Print Industry Trends, 2026 - Quocirca
hits.snippet: 9. Digital workflow automation will unlock new revenue streams. Two thirds of ITDMs expect scanning volumes to increase in 2026 as legacy workflows are digitised. Platform-based intelligent workflow services incorporating IDP, automation, and analytics will represent new opportunities as vendors evolve into transformation partners. [...] 2. AI-ready print and capture environments will unlock new value. Integrating AI directly onto MFP chipsets, developing AI literacy among sales and channel partners, and building function-specific AI-powered print offerings that integrate with CRM and ERP systems should be prioritised. [...] 10. The next-gen print partner will lead the shift to digital services. To stay relevant, OEMs and channel partners must evolve rapidly, offering a more diverse range of services and consultancy across cloud, security, sustainability, and AI. The most successful will evolve from print-based MPS specialists into broader IT service providers delivering deeply embedded solutions that form the foundation of AI-powered, data-driven business processes.
